body:
Part of #1831.

The v0.8 starting point settles the ordinary pool procedure: seven tokens start outside play; a faction that wins without receiving a token draws one at random if fewer than three standard tokens are in play. Income is collected at the end of the triggering phase. Carryall is separate.

The remaining question is which exceptional battle results count as a win for this award. Please specify eligibility for ordinary traitor, Break Conditioning, Guild Retreat, Lasgun-Shield explosions and Zoal Infiltration.

Carryall counting is tracked separately in #1845, and the Water Stealing exception in #1861.
title: Dreamrules ruling: Which exceptional battle results award a new tech token?
